name: What happens during a roof replacement assessment process?

mainEntity.name: What happens during a roof replacement assessment process?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a roof replacement assessment, a professional inspector will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of your roof's exterior, including shingles, flashing, and gutters, and often the attic space for signs of leaks or structural issues. Following the inspection, they will provide a detailed report outlining their findings, recommended solutions, and an estimate for any necessary work. This process helps clarify the scope and next steps for your roofing project.
acceptedAnswer.description: An inspector evaluates your roof's exterior and attic, then provides a detailed report and estimate.
